row.평가 축: 에이전트(VLSI 물리 설계: 지식·보고서 이해·근본 원인 분석·스크립트 생성·전체 플로우)
row.정의: VLSI 물리 설계 전 과정을 다루는 LLM/VLM 에이전트 벤치마크. 353개 문제로, 물리 설계 이해 133개(기초 지식 90, 보고서 이해 11, 근본 원인 분석 21, 정적 타이밍 분석 11)와 스크립트 생성 210개(Innovus 90, ICC2 88, ECO 10, Formality 22), 전체 RTL-to-GDSII 플로우 10개 설계로 구성된다. 이해·스크립트 과제는 pass@1/pass@5(자유 응답은 Claude Sonnet 4.6 LLM 판정과 루브릭)로, 전체 플로우는 단계별 WNS, 배치 밀도, DRC 위반 수로 평가한다. 논문은 모델 11종을 평가했다.
row.대표 과제: 기초 지식, 보고서 이해, 근본 원인 분석, STA, EDA 툴 스크립트 생성, 전체 플로우 구현
row.대표 예시·설명: 영어 시스템 프롬프트로 시니어 VLSI 물리 설계 엔지니어 역할을 주고 개념 질문에 답하게 하거나 툴 스크립트를 쓰게 한다. 전체 플로우 과제에서는 에이전트가 게이트 수준 넷리스트에서 시작해 EDA 툴 피드백으로 반복 개선한다.
row.이용 시 유의사항: 라이선스는 PDF에서 확인되지 않았다. 코드 저장소 라이선스는 데이터 라이선스를 대신하지 않는다. 초록은 저장소를 공개 예정이라고 적고 있어 실제 공개 여부와 내용 확인이 필요하다. 스크립트·전체 플로우 과제에는 Cadence Innovus, Synopsys ICC2·PrimeTime·Formality 같은 상용 EDA 툴과 TSMC 28nm 환경이 쓰이므로 각 툴의 이용 조건을 따로 확인해야 한다. 공개 버전은 오픈소스 PDK(Nangate45)와 OpenROAD 기반이라고 밝힌다. 자유 응답 채점에는 LLM 판정이 필요하다. LVS는 평가에서 제외되었고 데이터 규모와 다양성이 제한적이라고 논문이 밝힌다. 논문의 모델 비교는 논문 조건의 결과이며 현재 전역 리더보드가 아니다.

english_copy.axis: Agents (VLSI physical design: knowledge, report comprehension, root-cause analysis, script generation, full flow)
english_copy.definition: A benchmark for LLM/VLM agents across the VLSI physical design stack. It has 353 problems: 133 physical design understanding problems (90 foundational knowledge, 11 report comprehension, 21 root-cause analysis, 11 static timing analysis), 210 script generation problems (Innovus 90, ICC2 88, ECO 10, Formality 22), and a full RTL-to-GDSII flow on 10 designs. Understanding and script tasks use pass@1/pass@5 (free-response answers are scored by a Claude Sonnet 4.6 LLM judge with rubrics). Full-flow tasks report per-stage WNS, placement density, and DRC violation counts. The paper evaluates 11 models.
english_copy.task: Foundational knowledge, report comprehension, root-cause analysis, STA, EDA tool script generation, and full-flow implementation
english_copy.example: An English system prompt casts the model as a senior VLSI physical design engineer who answers conceptual questions or writes tool scripts. In full-flow tasks, the agent starts from a gate-level netlist and iteratively refines the design using EDA tool feedback (task description).

screening.paper_title: PDAGENT-BENCH: Characterizing, Grounding, and Architecting LLM/VLM Agents for VLSI Physical Design
screening.abstract: Large Language Models and vision-language models have shown remarkable success in the front-end design of Very Large-Scale Integrated Circuits, yet their capabilities for VLSI physical design remain significantly underexplored. The primary cause is the lack of standardized benchmarks for evaluating agentic physical design workflows that require high-dimensional, multi-stage optimization under strict design constraints, coordinated interaction with diverse Electronic Design Automation tools, and iterative refinement. This work introduces PDAGENT-BENCH, a comprehensive and multi-dimensional benchmark for evaluating LLM/VLM-based agents across the physical design stack. PDAGENT-BENCH integrates both task-level assessment and workflow-level execution. The benchmark suite contains 353 curated problems that combine conceptual questions with real-world industrial artifacts, with expert-validated references and executable solutions. In addition, the benchmark provides a unified, human-aligned agentic physical design workflow framework that enables closed-loop evaluation of holistic physical design in realistic EDA environments. Experiments on 11 state-of-the-art models reveal that while modern LLMs/VLMs perform competitively on conceptual tasks, they remain substantially limited in tool-centric execution (e.g., 42.2% on Innovus script generation) and long-horizon, multi-stage reasoning. Our studies further show that human-skill-enhanced agentic workflows significantly improve end-to-end physical design performance. PDAGENT-BENCH establishes a standardized, reproducible, and realistic evaluation framework for advancing LLM/VLM-driven holistic physical design automation. To ensure full reproducibility, we release \textsc{PDAgent-Bench} at https://github.com/fenggev56/PDAGENT-BENCH.
